sentences.text: This bail application is filed under section 482 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, 2023 (for short 'BNSS').

2. Petitioner is the sole accused in Crime No.648/2025 of Parippally Police Station, Kollam District alleging offence under Section 498A of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 apart from Section 296(b), and 115(2) of Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, 2023.

3. The prosecution case is that, the accused, who is the husband, of the de facto complainant, after their marriage on 23.07.2006 harassed her physically and mentally with cruelty, abused her and caused hurt to her, and thus committed the offence.

4. Having heard the learned counsel for the petitioner as well as the learned Public Prosecutor, I am of the view that since the offence alleged arose out of a matrimonial discord between the petitioner and the de facto complainant, the arrest of the petitioner is not essential.
The offences under Section 296(b) and 115(2) of BNS are bailable, and the only non- bailable offence alleged against the petitioner is under Section 498A of IPC.
Having regard to the facts and circumstances of the case and considering the nature of the allegations, I am of the opinion that petitioner can be granted anticipatory bail subject to conditions.
6. In the result, this application is allowed.

It is directed that the petitioner shall be released on anticipatory bail, in the event of his arrest in Crime No.648/2025 of Parippally Police Station,
subject to the following conditions:-
(i) Petitioner shall execute a separate bond for a sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees fifty thousand only) with two solvent sureties each for the like sum before the Investigating Officer.

sentences.text: (ii) Petitioner shall appear before the investigating officer in Crime No.648/2025 of Parippally Police Station, as and when required.
(iii) Petitioner shall not attempt to contact the de facto complainant or interfere with the investigation or to influence or intimidate any witness in Crime No.648/2025 of Parippally Police Station.
(iv) Petitioner shall not involve in any other crime while on bail.

If any of the aforesaid conditions are violated, the Investigating officer in Crime No.648/2025 of Parippally Police Station, may file an application before the jurisdictional Court for cancellation of bail.
